product_overview: A simple local e-commerce demo that lets visitors browse products, view details, authenticate with a hardcoded test account, simulate purchases, view order history, and perform admin product management in local state.
core_goals: Provide a browsable product catalog with detail pages
Support a demo authentication flow using a hardcoded test account
Allow simulated purchases that appear in a per-session order history
Expose a protected admin UI for add/edit/delete of products in local state
Keep the app runnable locally with no external services

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate a user using the hardcoded test account and redirect to the product catalog; show errors for invalid credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> Observe redirect to / -> See product catalog and logged-in navigation options
Navigate to /login -> Enter email (wrong@example.com) -> Enter password (wrong) -> Click Login button -> See invalid credentials error message
Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> See product catalog -> Refresh page -> See session reset (not logged in)

features.name: Catalog Browsing
features.description: Browse product cards on the catalog landing page and navigate to individual product details; Buy actions require authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See product cards list -> Scroll product card list -> Click View Details on a product card -> Navigate to /product/:id -> See product image, category, price, and description
Navigate to / -> See product cards list -> Click Buy on a product card (when not authenticated) -> Observe redirect to /login

features.name: Product Details View
features.description: Display full product information for a selected product and allow a simulated purchase flow; show not-found for invalid IDs.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> Navigate to /product/1 -> See product image, category, price, and description -> Click Buy -> See purchase success message -> Click Orders in top navigation -> Navigate to /orders -> See new order in order history
Navigate to /product/9999 -> See not found message
Navigate to /product/1 -> See product image, category, price, and description -> Click Buy (when not authenticated) -> Observe redirect to /login

features.name: Order History Access
features.description: Protected page showing a user's simulated order history after login.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> Click Orders in top navigation -> Navigate to /orders -> See order cards and order metadata
Navigate to /orders (when not authenticated) -> Observe redirect to /login

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Protected admin page for adding, editing, and deleting products stored in local component state only.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> Click Admin in top navigation -> Navigate to /admin -> Fill add product form fields -> Submit add product form -> See new product appear in admin product list

Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> Click Admin in top navigation -> Navigate to /admin -> Click Edit on a product -> Update product fields -> Click Update -> See updated product in admin product list
Navigate to /admin (when not authenticated) -> Observe redirect to /login

Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> Click Admin in top navigation -> Navigate to /admin -> Click Edit on a product -> Change a field -> Click Cancel -> See original product unchanged

Navigate to /login -> Enter email (example@gmail.com) -> Enter password (123456789) -> Click Login button -> Click Admin in top navigation -> Navigate to /admin -> Fill add product form fields -> Submit add product form -> See new product appear in admin product list -> Refresh page -> See added product missing (local state not persisted)

routes.description: Product catalog landing page with cards and buy/view actions
Login form that validates test credentials and authenticates the session
Product details page with image, metadata, and buy action
Protected order history page showing mock order cards
Protected admin product management page for add/edit/delete in local UI state

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with email and password and redirect to catalog
user_interactions: Observe redirect to catalog on valid credentials
Observe invalid credentials error message on wrong credentials

features.name: Catalog Browsing
features.description: View product cards and navigate to product details
user_interactions: Click View Details on a product card

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is client-side only and not persisted across refreshes.
known_limitations.impact: Session resets on page reload; no real backend auth.

known_limitations.issue: Product and order data are mock in-memory values without backend persistence.
known_limitations.impact: Changes are temporary and not shared across sessions.

known_limitations.issue: Admin CRUD operations update local component state only.
known_limitations.impact: Added/edited/deleted products are not saved to a backend database.
